people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
translations.bsb: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, yet it seemed but a few days because of his love for her.
